Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
— Open ground —
Wind moves through the grass in waves. Seeds catch on your clothes, hitching a ride.

◈ ARC II — THE SHOW. The sky tore open a week ago and the village is still here. Still eating. The audience has noticed. Strangers will come — not because the plot says so, but because surviving is worth watching.
⚔️ Nikolai stood down the Flashbulb Moth and kept walking — 2 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

◈ FLASHBACK — Coat button
The last winter before the scattering. You don't talk about it. The button remembers the weight of that coat, the cold that got in anyway, and who was wearing it.
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
The pantry is not yours anymore. Exile means exile — membership had no check-ins, but it had exactly one way to lose it.
Reason: defied exile. You did this.
📓 Codex: They killed Yara. The uprising died with them. I'm someone else now — the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
⚔️ Stan stood down the Old Big and kept walking — 4 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

◈ SYSTEM: "33. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
